reason: Adapter code is present, but a real smoke test and evaluation evidence are still required before routing can be enabled.

importantProviderSemantics.duration: The API controls duration with num_frames/frame_rate. This candidate exposes only the provider-documented approximately-5s and approximately-10s presets until real outputs are calibrated.
importantProviderSemantics.size: Requested width/height may be normalized by Agnes. The response fields seconds, size and metadata.size_mapping are the source of truth.
importantProviderSemantics.imageInput: Image-to-video requires a publicly accessible image URL. This candidate does not claim reference-video input or multi-reference semantic composition.
importantProviderSemantics.audio: The model-specific video request documentation does not expose an audio-generation parameter, so audio=true is rejected by the adapter.
importantProviderSemantics.retry: Create POST requests are never automatically retried because an ambiguous submission could create duplicate work.
